parts.t: Welcome to The Carrington in Morgan Creek! This spacious 2042 sq.ft. end-unit townhome offers 3 bedrooms + den/flex, 3 bathrooms and a highly desirable primary bedroom on the main. Bright living and dining areas, gas fireplace, functional kitchen and a private fenced patio/yard make this home easy to enjoy. Upstairs features a second bedroom, den/flex space and storage. Double garage plus visitor parking. Resort-style amenities include outdoor pool, hot tub, gym, clubhouse, guest suite and tennis / Pickle Ball courts. Gated 55+ community close to golf, shopping and transit!

v: Highly desirable primary bedroom on the main floor in a spacious 2,042 sq ft townhome.
Bright 3 bedroom plus den/flex end unit with generous living and dining spaces and gas fireplace.
Private fenced patio and yard providing comfortable outdoor living and entertaining space.
Outdoor pool, hot tub, gym, clubhouse, guest suite and tennis and pickleball courts.
Gated 55+ community in The Carrington, close to golf, shopping and transit.
